_comment: Draft. Align field names with the go/demos C2D template the CDP team provides with the listing repo before merging.
_org_policy_notes: No overrides expected: no external IP, no load balancer, no allUsers IAM binding.
Cloud Run uses ingress=all with IAM; only the Discovery Engine service agent is an invoker, which satisfies iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains.
If Argolis enforces run.allowedIngress=internal, the demo needs an override, because Gemini Enterprise calls the service over its public run.app URL.
